constraints.definition: CHECK (((NOT rewards_enabled) OR (verification_enabled AND (effective_date IS NOT NULL) AND (points_per_health_point IS NOT NULL) AND (max_daily_points IS NOT NULL))))

CHECK (((complete AND (score IS NOT NULL) AND (score = subtotal) AND workouts_complete AND recovery_complete AND (training_score IS NOT NULL) AND (recovery_score IS NOT NULL)) OR ((NOT complete) AND (score IS NULL))))
CHECK ((((code_ciphertext IS NULL) AND (code_encryption_version IS NULL)) OR ((code_ciphertext IS NOT NULL) AND (code_encryption_version IS NOT NULL) AND (code_encryption_version = 1))))
